# Samarian Group

> Samarian Group is a private family office in New York focused on venture investment and discreet counsel. By referral only.

Samarian Group is a private family office focused on venture investment and discreet counsel. We back founders over the long term and assist a select group of families with complex negotiations and introductions that are otherwise difficult to secure.

- Headquartered in the Heart of NYC, the world, the universe. Based in the vibrant hub of New York City, we operate seamlessly across borders. We conduct extensive business in the USA and abroad.
- Unlocking Insights. Our savvy interpretation of data and keen market insight guarantees tailored solutions for our clients. We delve into market dynamics and analyze their impact to unearth opportunities in both burgeoning and shifting markets.
- Global Networks, Decades in the Making. The Samarian team has spent decades nurturing high-level connections globally. Our network spans all major sectors, facilitating unmatched opportunities.
- Empower Your Potential. We thrive on pushing boundaries to unveil your boundless potential. Here, personal and professional growth harmonize, creating a positive synergy that uplifts both you and your company. Embrace the opportunity to stretch your potential to new heights, aiming for extraordinary achievements that illuminate your capabilities.
- New York Grit. Rooted in the audacity, endurance, and winning mindset of New York, our founders, regardless of their location, embody the spirit that defines the city. At Samarian Group, we bring the tenacity of New York to every venture we support.
- Action-Oriented. We possess a discerning eye for opportunities, coupled with decisive action. From early investments to enduring partnerships, we stand by you through the exhilarating peaks and inevitable valleys.

## People

- Alfred Zaccagnino, President & CEO: Alfred Zaccagnino, the President and Founder of Samarian, has guided the company's global growth, forging new horizons through strategic partnerships at home and abroad. His unique personal touch and the company's boutique approach ensure a deep understanding of clients' unique needs.
- Phil Leseur, Legal Advisor: In 2010, Phil Leseur joined Samarian Group, bringing his wealth of legal expertise to the team. His educational journey began at Queen's University in Kingston, Ontario, where he pursued his undergraduate degree and earned a Bachelor of Arts (Honours) with a major in Political Studies. He then returned to his hometown, Victoria, British Columbia, to attend law school at the University of Victoria, where he obtained his law degree.
- Micaela Mangot, VP of Global Business Development: Micaela Mangot brings a vibrant and diverse skill set to her role as VP of Global Business Development at Samarian Group. Her dynamic portfolio includes executing Samarian's business development strategy, implementing operations strategy, and nurturing investor relationships. Currently, she is focused on serving as a resource for portfolio companies assisting with critical operations such as hiring, business development, marketing, and networking.
- Jennifer Barone, Finance and Operations Manager: Jennifer Barone Percontino is the Finance and Operations Manager at the Samarian Group of Companies. In her current role, she plays a pivotal part in ensuring the company's performance and efficiency. Jennifer meticulously manages financial and business records, as well as the issuance and receipt of statements for the Samarian Team.
- Milène Jardine, Business Consultant: Milène Jardine is an award-winning leader, entrepreneur, and relationship builder who helps large and small companies develop and implement brand strategies. Milène spent 12+ years overseeing international production and building private labels for Macy's resulting in hundreds of millions of dollars in annual sales. Recently, Milène created her own business consulting firm and bespoke chocolate company.
- Wolfgang Heimerl, Senior Counsel: Wolfgang Heimerl serves as Senior Counsel and a seasoned litigator for the Samarian Group and its affiliated entities. His unique blend of education and early career experiences perfectly align with his role at Samarian Group.
- Major General John F. Wharton, U.S. Army, Retired: Major General John F. Wharton (U.S. Army Ret.) has dedicated over three decades to serving the Nation, retiring with extensive experience in leadership, technology, innovation, and logistics. He currently advises both public and private sector organizations on national security and technology acceleration, and is a Partner at One Defense, an initiative aimed at advancing defense technology through collaboration among DOD stakeholders, industry, startups, venture capital, and academia.
